mechanics.title: Excavation
mechanics.description: Hold the excavate key (default ~) while mining. Config options include max blocks per excavation, max distance, tool damage, hunger exhaustion, auto pickup, stop before/after tool breaks, block blocklist/allowlist, custom block groups and requiring a tool.

mechanics.title: Shape excavation
mechanics.description: Selectable excavation shapes, cycled with the "Cycle Shape" keybind.

mechanics.title: Sneak to excavate
mechanics.description: Server-side option letting clients without the mod trigger excavation by sneaking.

commands_and_keybinds: Option "Invert Activation" makes holding the key disable excavation instead
getting_started: Hold ~ while mining an ore vein.
editor_notes: Pack does not override the config; default limits unknown. Required on both sides.
name: Diggus Maximus Reborn
summary: Vein mining: hold the excavate key while breaking a block to also mine all connected identical blocks (ores, logs, etc.). Also supports shape excavation. Server settings override the client's.
